--- 2026-09-14: Task 2.5 -- fixed all 3 real findings from Task 2.1c ---

User asked PM to research and fix all 3 findings strictly. Research: EBU R128 confirms loudness normalization must target the final complete mix, not an isolated stem; ffmpeg's blurred-background-pad is the real industry convention for 16:9->9:16 conversion; live-confirmed via the actual installed edge-tts package that no Scottish voice exists upstream. Fixed: (1) audio_service._mix_project_sync now normalizes the final mixed signal (voice + ducked music) once, after the overlay, instead of only the pre-music voice stem -- real measured result now within the declared +/-1dB tolerance. (2) New _render_vertical_sync (second ffmpeg pass, blur-pad technique, audio copied not re-encoded) wired through a new aspect_ratio request field (default 16:9, byte-for-byte unchanged), a new video_jobs.mp4_path_vertical column (migration 005), a new download format, and a Step 5 UI toggle -- real ffprobe confirms the vertical output is genuinely 720x1280 (reused the existing-but-previously-unwired VIDEO_WIDTH_SHORTS/VIDEO_HEIGHT_SHORTS constants). (3) A title tooltip on Step 1's Scottish accent option/chip discloses it shares British's voice. While verifying #2 against the real app (not just tmp_path-mocked tests), found and fixed 2 more real, blocking bugs, both disclosed: the exact .hidden-on-.btn CSS trap already flagged in TRACKER.md Known Issues (fixed with the one real [hidden] rule that entry itself recommended), and a real init_db() migration-replay crash on any second real app restart once a non-idempotent ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN migration exists -- reproduced for real against the actual persisted data/app.db, fixed with a schema_migrations tracking table, re-verified by running the real-server test suite three times in a row against the already-migrated real db (10/10 pass every time, was failing to start at all before the fix). 530/530 full suite passes (up from 515), zero flakes this run, ruff/node --check clean. See task-2.5.md for the full record.
